Rules.Name: Sulfates to Avoid
Rules.Description: These ingredients are sulfates that should be avoided.

Rules.Name: Gentle Cleansers
Rules.Description: These ingredients are gentle cleansers that you want to look for.

Rules.Name: Cleansing Agents
Rules.Description: These ingredients are cleansing agents that could potentially be drying, but are not as harsh as sulfates.

Rules.Name: Clarifying Ingredients
Rules.Description: Shampoos with clarifying ingredients remove product and oil build up. These ingredients are not as harsh as sulfates, but should be used sparingly (avg of two times/month)

Rules.Name: Chelating Agents
Rules.Description: These ingredients bind with metal ions or metallic compounds and prevent them from adhering to your hair. They work to detox your hair from mineral and potentially toxic metal build up. Products with these ingredients should be used sparingly - up to once a month.

Rules.Name: Silicones to Use with Caution
Rules.Description: These ingredients are partially soluble silicones to avoid, but could possibly be shampooed out with a sulfate free shampoo (may build up and need a sulfate to remove.)

Rules.Name: Silicones to Avoid
Rules.Description: These ingredients are silicones that should be avoided.

Rules.Name: Water Soluble Silicones
Rules.Description: These are exceptions that are OK: (The raw ingredients dissolve in water and rinse off with plain water. Shampoo may or may not be necessary to remove products containing these ingredients).
Ingredients: Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein Hydroxypropyl Polysiloxane (water soluble)
Hydrolyzed Wheat protein/hydroxypropyl polysiloxane and cystine/silicone co-polymers
Steardimonium Hydroxypropyl Panthenyl PEG-7 Dimethicone Phosphate Chloride

Rules.Name: Waxes and Oils to Avoid
Rules.Description: These ingredients are waxes or non-natural oils that should be avoided.

Rules.Name: Oils to use with Caution
Rules.Description: These ingredients are oils that should be used with caution because they have the potential to build up and a cowash only routine might not be able to remove

Rules.Name: Drying Alcohols to Avoid
Rules.Description: These ingredients are drying alcohols that should be avoided.

Rules.Name: Moisturizing Alcohols
Rules.Description: These ingredients are moisturizing alcohols that you want to look for.

Rules.Name: Waxes
Rules.Description: These ingredients are waxes that are okay to use.

Rules.Name: Botanical Ingredients - Extracts and Oils
Rules.Description: These ingredients originate from plants (herbs, roots, flowers, fruits, leaves or seeds) and provide a wide variety of benefits including: cleansing, stimulating, nourishing, refreshing, soothing, moisturizing, normalizing and deodorizing. Botanical ingredients may appear in other categories if they serve a specific purpose to the curly girl method
Ingredients: Citrus Aurantium Dulcis (Sweet Orange) Peel Oil
PRUNUS AMYGDALUS DULCIS (SWEET ALMOND) FRUIT EXTRACT
PRUNUS AMYGDALUS DULCIS (SWEET ALMOND) SEED EXTRACT
sclerotium gum Citrus Aurantium Amara (Bitter Orange) Flower Water

Rules.Name: Proteins
Rules.Description: These ingredients are proteins that you can either avoid or look for, depending on your hair type. Some is good for the hair diet, especially damaged hair. However, normal hair, or protein sensitive hair could begin to feel stiff, frizzy, and dry, indicating your hair is getting too much protein.

Rules.Name: Polyquats
Rules.Description: These ingredients could cause build up on finer, thin hair

Rules.Name: Conditioning Agents
Rules.Description: These ingredients are Cationic Surfactants that can be an effective mild cleanser in a conditioner or as film-forming conditioning agents. They are water soluble, but some can build up over time.

Rules.Name: Parabens
Rules.Description: These ingredients are OK if you want to use them. There is nothing in them that will build up in your hair. Some believe they are a higher cancer risk and choose to avoid them. It's a personal choice

Rules.Name: Itchy M's
Rules.Description: These ingredients are preservatives from the family of substances called Isothiozalinones and are added to products to prevent the growth of micro-organisms. These ingredients should be avoided if you have sensitive skin, as they can make your scalp itchy and irritated

Rules.Name: Preservatives
Rules.Description: Preservatives are added to products to prevent the growth of micro-organisms.

Rules.Name: Humectants
Rules.Description: A humectant absorbs moisture and keeps a moisture balance in the hair and skin. Humectants will search for moisture in your own hair too. Therefore, in areas where it may be hot, but dry, these products may actually do more bad than good. In the right condition, humectants are materials used in products to moisturize dry or damaged hair.

Rules.Name: Film Forming Humectants
Rules.Description: Film forming humectants are excellent moisturizing ingredients that form a film over the hair and will help resist dehydration. These ingredients are safe to use in low dew points.
Ingredients: Aloe Barbadensis (Aloe Vera) Leaf Juice Powder
Certified Organic Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice

Rules.Name: Verified - Okay
Rules.Description: These ingredients have been verified as having no affect on curly hair and include ingredients like water, antioxidants, emulsifiers and thickeners

Rules.Name: Verified - Caution
Rules.Description: These ingredients have been verified as having no affect on curly hair but could be irritating to skin or have other negative effects. Please do more research on these ingredients to see if they will work for your individual needs
